summary: Initializes a 1024-byte (256-dword) permutation/state array from caller-supplied key material a1 of length a2, using an RC4-style key-schedule algorithm. Clears the state with memset, runs four outer passes, each doing two 256-step keyed permutation swaps over the key bytes, XORs each state dword with its index, then forwards the finished state to sub_564DD0(a3, 0, 0) whose result is returned.

local_names.a2: key length (wrap modulus for the key-byte index)
local_names.v6: running permutation accumulator (sum of key byte + state byte)
local_names.v9: swap destination index, (v6 + state byte + key byte) masked to 8 bits

operations.description: Initialize the state: a3[325] is set to 0, then memset zeroes the first 0x400 bytes of a3 (dword indices 0..255).
Outer loop i in 0..3: before each permutation pass every dword is expanded with a3[j] = j + (a3[j] << 8), seeding the state from the loop index.

Keyed permutation pass: two passes per outer iteration, each a 256-step do/while loop over v7; v8 = a3[v7], v9 = (v6 + v8 + key byte a1[(v7++ % a2)]) masked to 8 bits, v6 = v9, then a3[v7-1] = a3[v9] and a3[v9] = v8 (swap).
The key-byte index wraps at the key length a2 (v7 % a2); the permutation state and key bytes are combined through the running byte accumulator v6.
Final scrambling loop k in 0..255: each state dword is XORed with its own index (a3[k] ^= k).
Post-process the completed state: return sub_564DD0(a3, 0, 0), passing the 256-dword state and two zero arguments; the callee's result becomes this function's return value.
